answer_1.quote: Starting with a carefully crafted set of dialogues ... we engage a large teacher model to iteratively generate a large number of generalized and high-quality emotional support conversations.
answer_1.outputs: Emotional support responses in multi‑turn conversations

answer_2.quote: We used automatic evaluation metrics ... METEOR, BLEU-4 (B-4), ROUGE-L (R-L), Vector Extrema and Distinct-2/3.

answer_4.quote: We engaged five master's students as annotators, assessing 50 randomly selected dialogues ... The scores (from 0 to 3) are averaged over all the samples rated by three annotators.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation framework comes with a set of guidelines provided in Appendix L, specifying the criteria on which annotators rate each dialogue.
